calls.summary: Melissa Grant called to switch from her old cable provider to Optimum Fiber 1 Gig at her new address. Agent Oscar confirmed fiber availability at her service address, walked her through the Smart Wi-Fi 6 router that is included, and locked in the roughly $65 per month rate. He scheduled her fiber internet installation for the following week and she was thrilled.

David Okafor wanted to bundle internet, TV, and mobile onto a single bill. Agent Lila built him an Internet plus TV plus Mobile triple play, added two Optimum Mobile Unlimited lines, and confirmed the bundle discount. She booked the installation for Saturday morning and the call closed on a positive note.

Priya Nair called to upgrade to the Optimum TV Select package so she could keep her local channels and News 12 access. Agent Rosey added multi-room DVR and confirmed the 220 plus channel lineup. She scheduled the equipment installation for Thursday and thanked the agent for the quick help.

New customer Anthony Russo called to sign up for service after moving into the area and asked about the fastest home plan. Agent Mary collected his name, service address, phone number, and email, confirmed fiber was live on his street, and recommended Optimum Fiber 2 Gig with whole-home mesh Wi-Fi. She completed the intake and scheduled his installation for the following Tuesday.

Sandra Choi runs a small design studio and called about Optimum Business Internet with a static IP. Agent Lee explained the priority support and SLA, quoted the plan near $120 per month, and answered her questions about business Wi-Fi. She agreed and he scheduled the business internet installation for the end of the week.

Karen Liu called to compare the Optimum Mobile By the Gig plan against her current carrier. Agent Mike explained the $15 per gig pricing and the internet-customer discount, and confirmed she could bring her own device. She said she would think it over and did not commit on the call.

Robert Alvarez called to check the status of his shipped Wi-Fi gateway before his upcoming service date. Agent Jennifer tracked the equipment and confirmed it would arrive within 24 to 48 hours. She reassured him the timing still lined up and no changes were needed.

Teresa Vaughn disputed a billing charge for a service tier change she said she never requested. Agent Sue reviewed the account, found a promotional rate had expired, and applied a one-time credit. Teresa remained frustrated about the billing surprise but accepted the adjustment.

Gregory Pham called because a technician missed his scheduled installation window. Agent Rose apologized, confirmed the order, and rebooked the installation for the next available day. He was unhappy about the delay but agreed to the new time.

Nadia Foster reported that her modem kept dropping the connection and asked for a repair. Agent Mike ran remote diagnostics, could not fully resolve it, and arranged a replacement gateway to be sent out. She was tired of the repeated resets by the end of the call.

Marcus Webb called to cancel his Optimum TV Premier package because he felt the price was too high. Agent Oscar offered a downgrade to a smaller lineup, but Marcus declined and asked to proceed with the cancel request. The agent processed the change and confirmed the final bill.

Diane Kelly called angry about a billing overcharge on her latest statement. Agent Lila explained a partial-month proration but could not fully satisfy Diane, who felt the charges were never clearly disclosed. A supervisor callback was requested to review the billing dispute.

Paul Ramsey called to cancel his internet service because he is moving out of the Optimum footprint. Agent Lee checked for coverage at his new city but confirmed it was unavailable, so the cancellation was processed. Paul was disappointed he could not keep his internet plan.

Vanessa Cole called after hours with a question about switching her Optimum Mobile plan and adding a line. The call rolled to voicemail and no agent was available to assist. She left a callback number and asked for someone to reach out about mobile options.

Henry Doss called to complain about a prolonged internet outage in his neighborhood that had lasted most of the day. Agent Jennifer confirmed a known area disruption and could only give an estimated restore time, which frustrated him further. He demanded a credit and the outage remained unresolved at the end of the call.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: The caller is relocating to a new residence and needs to establish broadband service. They are dissatisfied with their current provider's speeds and want to upgrade to fiber for streaming and gaming.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The customer expects fast and reliable fiber internet service with an installation in the coming week. They also inquired about bundling TV service and promotional pricing but these expectations were not fully addressed.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the customer's email address for confirmation and follow-up, fully verified fiber availability in the system before booking the appointment, and discussed promotional offers and equipment details to manage expectations before installation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Optimum. This is Marcus speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, I'm moving to a new place and I need to set up internet service. Do you guys have fiber in my area?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, I can definitely help you with that. May I have your full name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it's Jennifer Martinez.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Jennifer. And what is the ZIP code for your new address?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's 10024, in Manhattan.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. We do serve that area with fiber. What speed are you looking for in a plan?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I'm not sure. What do you recommend? I work from home and I do a lot of streaming.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: For work from home and streaming, I'd suggest our Optimum Fiber 1 Gig plan at 65 dollars per month. It has symmetrical speeds and works great for multiple devices.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That sounds good. When can you get someone out to install it?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We can schedule an installation visit for you. Would next Thursday or Friday work better for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thursday next week would be perfect for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. Let me get your phone number to confirm the appointment. What's the best number to reach you at?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. Jennifer, we'll send you a confirmation text with your installation window. Our technician will arrive between 8 AM and 12 PM on Thursday. You'll receive a router with your service, and our team will set everything up for you.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you so much, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Jennifer. Thank you for choosing Optimum, and have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Martinez called to set up fiber internet service at her new residence in Manhattan, ZIP code 10024. Marcus confirmed fiber availability in the area and recommended the Optimum Fiber 1 Gig plan at 65 dollars per month based on Jennifer's work from home and streaming needs. An installation appointment was scheduled for Thursday of the following week, with a technician window between 8 AM and 12 PM. The agent did not capture the customer's email address or fully verify fiber availability in the provisioning system before confirming the appointment.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, great job on greeting Jennifer warmly, capturing her full details, and closing the call smoothly. The recommendation for Fiber 1 Gig was spot on for her use case. Next time, please grab the customer's email address before hanging up so you can send written confirmation and reduce call-backs. Also, confirm fiber availability in the system before you quote it, just to be sure. Well done on the structure overall.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Optimum, this is Marcus. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, my name is Danielle Foster. I just moved into a new place and I'm trying to get internet set up.

transcript.text: Congratulations on the new home, Danielle. I can definitely help you get connected. Can I grab the service address so I can check what's available there?

transcript.text: Sure, it's 118 Maple Ridge Drive. It's just me and my partner, but we both work from home and stream a lot in the evenings.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that address is in our fiber footprint, so you've got some great options. For two people working from home and streaming, I'd point you toward Optimum Fiber 1 Gig, which is symmetrical one gigabit with a Smart Wi-Fi 6 router included.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds fast. What does that one run per month?

transcript.text: The 1 Gig plan is about sixty-five a month with no annual contract, and the router is included at no extra charge.

transcript.text: Hmm. I want to keep it manageable, honestly. Verizon quoted me something in that same range and I'm still comparing the two.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's a fair comparison to make. Where Optimum stands out is the symmetrical speed, so your upload is just as fast as your download, which really matters for video calls all day. And there's no contract, so you're never locked in.

transcript.text: That upload part actually matters a lot for my job. I do a lot of large file transfers.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Then the 1 Gig is a strong fit. If you ever find you need more headroom, we can bump you to Fiber 2 Gig with whole-home mesh, but 1 Gig will handle two remote workers comfortably.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer fiber internet at my address?
qaPairs.answer: Fiber availability depends on your exact address and whether you're in the Optimum East or Optimum West footprint. Share your ZIP code and I'll confirm availability, then set up a consultation to lock in your plan.

qaPairs.question: What internet speeds do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: We offer cable plans around 300 and 500 Mbps and symmetrical fiber tiers from 1 Gig up to 8 Gig. I can recommend the right tier once I know how many people and devices are in your home, then book an installation.

qaPairs.question: How much is your 1 Gig fiber plan?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing varies by address and current promotions, so I can only give a preliminary range over text. Let's set up a quick consultation with a specialist for an exact quote tied to your address.

qaPairs.question: Can I bundle internet, TV, and mobile?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our triple play bundle combines broadband, video, and wireless on a single bill with a discount. Tell me your ZIP code and I'll check availability, then schedule your installation.

qaPairs.question: Do you require an annual contract?
qaPairs.answer: Our internet plans come with no annual contract and include the Wi-Fi gateway. I can walk you through the details during a consultation and get your installation booked.

qaPairs.question: What channels come with Optimum TV?
qaPairs.answer: TV Select carries 220 plus channels including local channels and News 12, while Premier adds premium networks and a multi-room DVR. Let's confirm the package that fits and schedule your installation.

qaPairs.question: Is there a self-install option or do you send a technician?
qaPairs.answer: Many setups qualify for professional in-home installation to make sure everything runs smoothly. Share your ZIP and I'll confirm service, then book an installation window for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer mobile phone service?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Optimum Mobile runs on a nationwide 5G network with By the Gig and Unlimited plans, plus discounts for internet customers. I can include mobile in your quote and set up your installation.

qaPairs.question: How fast can I get installed?
qaPairs.answer: Install timelines depend on your area and technician availability, but we often have openings within a few days. Give me your ZIP code and I'll find the soonest installation slot.

qaPairs.question: Can I bring my own router or modem?
qaPairs.answer: Our plans include a Wi-Fi gateway, and some fiber tiers come with a Smart Wi-Fi 6 router or mesh coverage. A specialist can review your setup during the consultation before your installation.

qaPairs.question: Do you have plans for gamers or heavy streamers?
qaPairs.answer: Our symmetrical fiber tiers from 2 Gig and up offer low latency and whole-home coverage ideal for gaming and simultaneous streaming. Let's confirm fiber at your address and book an installation.

qaPairs.question: Is unlimited data included?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our internet plans include unlimited data with no overage fees. I can confirm the right tier for your household and get your installation scheduled.

qaPairs.question: What is the Price for Life offer?
qaPairs.answer: It's a promotion that keeps your qualifying internet rate steady with no annual contract required. Availability varies, so let's set up a consultation to confirm current offers and book your installation.

qaPairs.question: Do you serve my ZIP code?
qaPairs.answer: I can check that right now if you share your ZIP code. Once I confirm service, I'll give you a preliminary price range and schedule your installation.

qaPairs.question: Can I get a prepaid card reward for switching?
qaPairs.answer: Switch offers like prepaid Visa rewards come and go by area and promotion. Share your ZIP and I'll confirm current incentives, then book your installation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer service for small businesses?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Optimum Business offers fiber and cable internet with static IP, business Wi-Fi, and hosted voice with priority support. I can set up a consultation to size the right plan and book your installation.

qaPairs.question: How much is a TV and internet bundle?
qaPairs.answer: Bundle pricing depends on the speed tier, channel package, and your address, so I can share a rough range over text. Let's schedule a consultation for an exact quote and book your installation.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between cable and fiber plans?
qaPairs.answer: Cable plans deliver fast download speeds while fiber offers symmetrical upload and download with lower latency. I can confirm which is available at your address and get your installation booked.

qaPairs.question: Can I add HBO or Showtime?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, premium networks are available as add-ons, and the Premier package includes premium options with a multi-room DVR. Let's confirm your package and schedule your installation.

qaPairs.question: How do I switch from my current provider?
qaPairs.answer: We make switching simple and can often align your install date with your current service ending. Share your ZIP code and I'll confirm availability, then book your installation.
